executive_summary: Baseline architecture compliance audit for core modules (Multi-Tenancy, Auth, Stripe, Marketing Consent).
feature_or_campaign: BusinessBrain Foundation & Core Modules Baseline (Auth, Subscriptions, Multi-Tenancy, Marketing Consent)

official_sources.summary: Requisitos de licitude, consentimento explícito, dever de informação e segurança técnica.
Obrigatoriedade de cancelamento online em 1-2 passos e avisos pré-renovação de planos recorrentes.

confirmed_obligations: Terms and privacy consent separation in signup flow
Stripe webhook cryptographic verification with signing secret
RLS multi-tenancy isolation on every tenant table
Online 1-click self-service cancellation via Customer Portal
Strict opt-in requirement for marketing cookies and promotional communications

risks.title: Cross-border data transfers to US cloud subprocessors
risks.description: Cloud infrastructure (Stripe, Supabase) hosted in or managed from the United States.

acceptance_conditions.requirement: Verify active DPA with EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework certification or Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs).
acceptance_conditions.evidence: Verified active DPA with Stripe, Inc. and Supabase, Inc. incorporating SCCs (Decisão de Execução (UE) 2021/914) and DPF certification.

risks.title: Continuous automatic renewal disclosure and consumer cancellation mechanism
risks.description: Subscriptions automatically bill on recurring cadence without pre-renewal surprises.

acceptance_conditions.requirement: Verify clear disclosure of renewal frequency, billing amount, and self-service online cancellation button.
acceptance_conditions.evidence: Verified checkout disclosure on pricing tiers and self-service cancellation via Stripe Customer Portal.

market_divergences: EU/UK/BR: Opt-in strictly mandatory before sending direct electronic marketing.
US Federal (CAN-SPAM): Opt-out permitted with valid postal address and functioning unsubscribe.
technical_recommendations: Maintain strict separation of marketing checkbox and Terms checkbox on registration.
Keep client-side Stripe price IDs isolated from direct user manipulation.
operational_recommendations: Audit DPA agreements with vendors annually.
Monitor California AB 390 and ROSCA enforcement actions.
contractual_requirements: DPA incorporating SCCs with all third-party cloud data processors.
